name: Shardmind Executioner
tactics: A shardmind executioner relentlessly pursues its chosen foe. It assaults its quarry’s mind, sending the enemy to a strange dreamscape of endless corridors and shadowy chambers. In this maze of the mind, the executioner remains on its prey’s heels, fostering feelings of helplessness and terror in its victim.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is blinded until the end of the executioner’s next turn.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature that cannot see the executioner

hit.description: The target takes ongoing 20 psychic damage and is dazed (save ends both). Until the target saves against this effect or drops to 0 hit points or fewer, the executioner is removed from play. When this effect ends, the executioner appears in an unoccupied square of its choice adjacent to the target.

effect.description: Each enemy adjacent to the executioner grants combat advantage until the end of the executioner’s next turn. The executioner then teleports 3 squares.

powers.name: Psionic Boost
powers.trigger: The executioner hits with shardblade or mind shadows.

effect.description: The attack deals 2d6 extra psychic damage.
